name: weather-effect-gnome
description: Adds a weather effect (snow or rain) to your GNOME wallpaper.

scripts.typecheck: test -x ./node_modules/.bin/tsc || { echo 'TypeScript is not installed; run npm ci first.' >&2; exit 1; }; ./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.validate: npm run validate:static && npm run typecheck
scripts.build: npm run validate && scripts/build.sh --clean && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && scripts/build.sh --pack
